messages:
violet: quick follow-up from the yesterday's postmortem — we observed a recurring KV-cache stall that pushed large-context p95 way above target. need to lock owners for SLO edits, dashboard slices, and recurrence detection.

mark: +1. main asks from postmortem: (1) scoped SLO for large-context requests, (2) dashboard + alert for repeated root cause, (3) short-term batching rollback window + long-term tuning. who picks each?

priya: I can take the SLO proposal & governance ticket. plan: write measurement queries showing baseline vs incident, propose scoped SLO: p95=250ms for requests with ctx>2k OR tokens>4096. ETA 48h.

gwen: i'll own dashboards and alerts. will add per-route/model p50/p95/p99, rolling burn-rate, and a recurrence alert that triggers when the same postmortem tag appears 3x in 60 days. creating ticket now (G-3345). ETA 36h.

mark: i'll own the runtime mitigations: prototype an adaptive throttle using in-flight queue length + kv-hit fraction, plus a short rollback switch for batching defaults. aim: staging repro today, draft PR in 4 business days.

violet: note on error budgets: recommendation is to NOT reset. this is systemic and the burn should remain visible to prioritize infra work. we'll document an exception window for measurement while the scoped SLO is under review.

priya: ack on no-reset. i'll include the exception window in the SLO ticket and request product + reliability sign-off. tagging @product-team in the ticket.

gwen: dash ticket G-3345 created with panels + a widget "recent postmortems" linking to docs. alert rule: fire if same root_cause tag in >=3 incidents within 60d. also added a quick-link to traces.

mark: posted staging repro and traces: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442. throttle prototype in PR-5102 (draft) — uses kv_hit_ratio < 0.6 && inflight > 250 as initial heuristic. will tune after staging runs.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-02 11:00 UTC to review owner progress (priya, gwen, mark).

violet: owners summary: priya (SLO ticket + governance) - 48h, gwen (dash + alerts) - 36h, mark (throttle + rollback plan) - PR in 4bd, violet (postmortem update + runbook edits) - 24h. schedule 2-week follow-up to verify recurrence suppression and validate metrics.

priya: opened SLO ticket SLO-2026-220 with measurement queries, scoped-SLO text, and product tag. requested sign-off by EOD +2d.

gwen: dash panels pushed to staging dashboard, alert test added (simulated events). will promote to prod after SLO sign-off.

mark: plan for batching rollback: canary at 1% -> 10% then full if no regressions. violet, can you coordinate infra canary window?

violet: yes i'll book canary and coordinate with infra. calendar invite sent for 2026-03-30 09:30 UTC.

violet: final note — keep error budget unreset. we'll rely on the recurrence alert + dashboard to drive urgency. closing thread, please update tickets as you make progress. thanks all :thumbsup:
